ddl.where: "deleted_at" is null and "code" is not null
ddl.name: projects_workspace_id_code_unique

ddl.where: "start_at" is not null and "end_at" is null
ddl.name: time_entries_one_running_per_user_unique

ddl.name: time_entries_interval_or_duration_check

ddl.name: time_entries_task_requires_project_check
